title: A true professional
quote: Dasha is a true professional: she always meets her deadlines and takes her work very seriously. We worked together on two short films, and she was always willing to listen to my vision for the project, offer her own ideas, and make as many revisions as needed. She also brought things to the table that I never would have thought of. She's patient, empathetic, and understands video production from both the technical and creative sides. She's an absolute pleasure to work with. Highly recommend!
name: Short film director
